notes: Dates keep the day of the month as a numeral ("10 October"): en-IN voices read it naturally.
Keypad keys are written as numerals ("press 1"); every Indic file writes them as words.
charsPerSecond is the slowest message+menu rate measured by scripts/sampark/verify-voice.ts on 2026-09-30 with the live voice and style prompt (conservative, so the 38 s budget warning fires early).

closureReasons.rain_landslide: heavy rain and the danger of landslides

common.opt_out_confirm: Just to be sure, press 9 once more to stop these calls. You will still hear from us if the school ever has to close in an emergency.
common.opt_out_done: All right, we won't send you these calls any more. You will still hear from us if the school has to close in an emergency. Thank you, and take care.
common.no_input: Thank you for listening. Have a good day.
common.fallback_office: Namaste, this is {schoolName}. We couldn't play our message just now, so please get in touch with the school office. Thank you.

ptm_invite.message: Namaste! This is a recorded message from {schoolName} for {audience}. The parent-teacher meeting is on {date}, at {time}, {venue}, and we'd love to see you.
ptm_invite.menu: If you can come, please press 1. If it doesn't suit you, press 2. If you'd rather not get these calls, press 9.
ptm_invite.confirm_1: Thank you! We've let the school know you're coming. We look forward to seeing you.
ptm_invite.confirm_2: Thank you for letting us know. Please have a word with the class teacher or the school office, and they will help you find another time.

event_invite.message: Namaste! This is a recorded message from {schoolName} for {audience}. You and your family are warmly invited to our {eventName} on {date}, at {time}, {venue}.
event_invite.menu: If you can come, please press 1. If you can't make it, press 2. If you'd rather not get these calls, press 9.
event_invite.confirm_1: Thank you! We've let the school know you're coming. See you there.
event_invite.confirm_2: Thank you for letting us know. We hope to see you at the next one.

message.today: Namaste. This is an urgent recorded message from {schoolName}. Because of {reason}, the school will stay closed today, {date}. {buses}
message.tomorrow: Namaste. This is an urgent recorded message from {schoolName}. Because of {reason}, the school will stay closed tomorrow, {date}. {buses}

buses.running: School buses will still run as usual.
buses.notRunning: School buses will not run either.

emergency_closure.menu: Please press 1 to let us know you've heard this message. If you'd rather not get these calls, press 9.
emergency_closure.confirm_1: Thank you. Please take care, and stay safe.
